defect.summary: Gate 4 leg A (assessHold) returns SILENT with 0 examined when the hold window contains no records. Ruling R7: an instrument that could not look must say CANNOT_ASSESS with the reason named, never SILENT. Expected fix: zero in-window records reads CANNOT_ASSESS, reason 'hold window empty'. Leg B stays vacuous; 'one leg wired, one leg vacant' stands. What a hold window IS in this deployment (R4) remains an open proxy definition; this fix makes the empty case honest without answering R4, and says so on the reader's own ceiling text.

arbiter.word: I open the core for this one defect, Gate 4 saying nothing wrong over an empty room. Could not look is could not look. Go as far as the reader honestly can, name the gap, close the door on the 29th.
